project: Redwood Materials South Carolina Campus (Camp Hall, Ridgeville)
current_status: PRODUCING; first operations online at SC campus (initial 20,000 metric tons/yr materials recovery/production); phased buildout over the next decade
notes: More than 600-acre campus at Camp Hall Commerce Park in Ridgeville; anode/cathode battery-component manufacturing plus recycling, targeting enough material for ~100 GWh/yr of battery cells; distinct from Redwood's Nevada campus.
retracted_reason: Duplicate of #48: the same Dec 2022 release (Camp Hall, Ridgeville, SC, $3.5B, 1,500 jobs), published twice under two names.

project: GSK Upper Merion Biologics Flex Factory
current_status: PRE-CONSTRUCTION; construction expected to begin 2026, no groundbreaking reported
notes: New biologics 'flex' factory at GSK's existing Upper Merion (King of Prussia) campus, Montgomery County, PA, to make biologics for respiratory disease (COPD/asthma) and cancer. Part of GSK's broader $30bn US 5-year investment commitment.
retracted_reason: No figure for this site meets the bar. GSK's $1.2B covers five new U.S. plants, not this one alone.

current_status: CLOSING; Gardasil bulk-substance production being wound down at the Durham site, 154 layoffs effective by May 1, 2026
notes: New $1B, 225,000-sq-ft bulk-substance plant on Merck's Durham NC campus (occupied since 2004), opened March 11, 2025 and described as 'slated to produce bulk substance' for Gardasil/Gardasil 9 HPV vaccine. By Feb 2026 Merck notified state officials (notice dated Feb. 24) it would wind down Gardasil production at the site and lay off 154 workers (147 at 5352 Old Oxford Road + 7 at 100 Rodolphe Street) effective by May 1, 2026, citing a ~39% worldwide drop in Gardasil demand. Lead summary cites an original ~2021 project announcement, but no cited source dates it.
retracted_reason: Below the bar on its real promise. The cited 2025 release marks the plant's opening; Merck's July 2019 promise was up to $650M and 391 jobs.
